images.title: Across the lagoon
images.alt: A wooden deck looks across pale turquoise water toward small boats and a cloudy island skyline.
images.caption: The lagoon was quiet beneath a sky that looked ready to open up.

images.title: Last light
images.alt: Two people stand ankle-deep in the sea as a boat passes across a darkening horizon.
images.caption: The last boat out made the evening feel briefly cinematic.

images.title: Under the sea grape tree
images.alt: A person sits on a low tree branch in the shade, looking out at waves breaking on a bright beach.
images.caption: A little shade, the sound of waves, and nowhere else to be.

images.title: Green by the roadside
images.alt: Close-up of bright green leaves and curling tendrils beside a sunlit island road.
images.caption: Even the edges of the road had their own small jungle.
